title: transfer_leader to a learner makes the learner run an election and panics its RaftCore
cause: The RaftMsg::TransferLeader handler calls Engine::elect() for to == self.id without the is_voter guard used by the other elect() callers; a learner candidate then grants itself and Candidate::grant_by panics because its progress holds voters only.
trigger: Call Raft::transfer_leader(leader_vote, learner_id, last_log_id) on the cluster nodes (as documented) with a caught-up learner as the target.
consequence: The learner's RaftCore panics (Fatal::Panicked) and the voters, whose leases the transfer disabled, grant the learner's higher vote, deposing the healthy leader until an election timeout.
premises: A learner holds the leader's committed vote after replication.
The public transfer_leader API forwards a TransferLeader message to the target without validating that it is a voter.
SaveVote delivers the self vote response before any remote response on the FIFO notification channel.
